text: {"features":[{"name":"Foundational training","description":"Depth of formal computer-science training presented as preparation for the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents a bachelor's degree or equivalent as baseline preparation, with no graduate-level training."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents bachelor's-level training plus some added signal of technical rigor, but no graduate degree in a relevant field."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly states a master's degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly states a doctoral degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents advanced graduate training in a way that directly reinforces deep preparation for complex systems or security engineering work."}]},{"name":"Experience scope","description":"Breadth of professional software experience in production environments.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter describes roughly minimum-level experience, such as about 2 to 3 years and a narrow production footprint with limited services or launches."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter describes moderate experience, such as about 3 to 5 years with some production launches but still modest breadth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid mid-level breadth through around 5 years of work or several services across testing, maintenance, and launch."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong breadth through repeated ownership of multiple production services over about 5 to 7 years."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents extensive production experience, typically around 7 or more years with many launches or clear end-to-end responsibility across several services."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"Strength of evidence that Go is a core professional language for the applicant’s backend work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go is mentioned only briefly, with little indication of depth or centrality."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Go appears to be one of several working languages, but the letter gives limited evidence that it is a main tool."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter makes clear that Go is used regularly on production systems, often as a primary or frequent language."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Go is explicitly framed as the applicant’s principal or daily language for backend service work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter positions Go as a dominant language and ties it to concrete design or ownership of relevant backend infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"Strength of evidence of professional Python usage relevant to automation or services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Python is not mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned only in passing or as a secondary familiarity without concrete use cases."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular Python use for tooling, automation, prototypes, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes extensive or daily Python use across multiple production or operational contexts."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as production-grade expertise, such as building services or shared tooling others rely on with clear engineering rigor."}]},{"name":"AI production experience","description":"Depth of direct experience building or operating AI features in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No AI experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"AI is mentioned only broadly or aspirationally, with little evidence of hands-on work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter claims direct work with AI or LLM-backed features but gives limited detail on deployment context."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly describes shipping AI features in production and handling reliability or operational concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows mature AI experience by pairing production delivery with evaluation, trustworthiness, or failure-mode handling."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture experience","description":"Relevance and depth of experience designing systems that combine agents with surrounding infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agentic or agent-based work is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions automation that could be adjacent to agents, but does not clearly describe agentic systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states direct agentic or agent-based experience, but the design details are thin."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly describes architectures with Python agents and Go or similar services providing constraints or coordination."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong end-to-end ownership of agentic systems, including bounded actions, permissions, auditing, supervision, or similar control mechanisms."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"Depth of hands-on experience evaluating systems for security issues.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no clear evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter signals security interest or literacy, but assessment work itself is vague or indirect."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states direct participation in security reviews or assessments."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter gives concrete forms of assessment work, such as threat modeling, code review, service reviews, or release-cycle assessments."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents structured assessment experience with clear methodology or follow-through, such as documenting findings, validating fixes, or approaching reviews as design analysis."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation ownership","description":"Strength of evidence of building tooling that automates vulnerability intake, triage, or report handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No vulnerability-handling automation is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter alludes to security automation or queue work, but the vulnerability workflow is not clearly explained."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the applicant automated some part of vulnerability triage or report handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes concrete triage mechanics such as classification, routing, deduplication, or prioritization that reduced manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents this automation as a significant owned system that materially transformed how vulnerability reports were handled."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"Evidence of practical fluency with data structures and algorithms in production engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Data structures and algorithms are not mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter gestures at algorithmic interest or strength without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter claims solid algorithmic ability and gives at least one example of applying it."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter provides a specific production example where a better algorithm or data structure improved system behavior."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows especially strong practical fluency through a concrete, technically meaningful example that solved a hard bottleneck or class of bugs."}]},{"name":"Role understanding","description":"How well the letter demonstrates an accurate, nuanced understanding of this team’s security-engineering mandate.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads as a generic security or software application with little sign of this role’s specific mission."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions one relevant theme, such as automation or secure development, but without much depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a workable understanding of at least one core responsibility, such as vulnerability response, secure defaults, or AI-enabled tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter connects several parts of the mandate, such as large-scale security automation, agentic tooling, and support for developer teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows nuanced understanding of the role as developer-facing security infrastructure that scales expert judgment and embeds best practices across the development lifecycle."}]},{"name":"Motivation strength","description":"Clarity and authenticity of the applicant’s personal reason for pursuing this role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The motivation is generic, thin, or interchangeable with many software jobs."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter states sincere interest, but the reasons remain broad and not very personal."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives a clear personal reason tied to security, infrastructure, or backend engineering."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter persuasively links prior experience and future direction to this specific role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers a memorable, authentic rationale that makes the application feel purposefully targeted rather than merely qualified."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"Degree to which the letter frames security work as helping developers through usable tooling and low-friction practices.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not discuss developers as users of the security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter hints at reducing toil or helping teams, but the idea is not developed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly values helping engineers or removing manual work through tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly frames security as enabling developers through better defaults, better workflows, or reduced friction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly and convincingly treats security as an internal product for developers, emphasizing adoption, practical usability, and secure behavior by default."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concretely the letter supports its claims with examples, context, and outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on generic assertions, buzzwords, or unsupported skill lists."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few specific tasks or examples, but claims still feel lightly supported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides several concrete examples, though outcomes are often implied rather than explicit."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter backs major claims with clear examples and observable engineering or operational results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently ties claims to concrete systems, decisions, and outcomes that make the applicant’s impact easy to picture."}]},{"name":"Security practice beyond work","description":"Strength of supplementary security development outside normal job duties, such as certifications or competitive practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of extra security development outside day-to-day job work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a light external signal, such as occasional competition participation or a foundational certification."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows one solid supplementary signal, such as regular CTF participation or a recognized certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong outside validation, such as rigorous certification or high-performing competitive participation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter combines multiple strong outside signals, such as demanding certification together with sustained competitive or community security practice."}]},{"name":"Independent engineering initiative","description":"Strength of self-directed engineering activity outside primary job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No self-directed technical building or contribution outside work is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small personal project or one-off contribution with limited depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a meaningful side project or consistent upstream contribution beyond a passing mention."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes either a substantial personally built system or real maintenance responsibility for an open-source project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows major self-directed engineering through technically demanding systems work, sustained open-source stewardship, or both."}]},{"name":"Mechanical accuracy","description":"Degree of spelling, grammar, and sentence-level correctness.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent errors repeatedly distract the reader or undermine professional credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Many noticeable errors appear, though the overall meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Some errors or awkward constructions appear, but the letter remains readable without much strain."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Only minor isolated errors are present in otherwise polished sentence-level writing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The writing is essentially error-free and professionally polished at the sentence level."}]},{"name":"Organizational clarity","description":"How clearly the letter is structured into a coherent and easy-to-follow case for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter feels disjointed, list-like, or poorly sequenced, making the case hard to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a basic structure, but sections feel choppy, abrupt, or weakly connected."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter follows a clear conventional arc from background to fit to close."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is well organized, with smooth transitions and a cumulative argument."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter uses especially effective structure or narrative flow that makes the application memorable and easy to absorb."}]}]}
